entries.body:
Enter Linking Mode by holding the Universal Controller, and doing shift + right-click

----------
I am going to start by saying: this mode needs work. 

Not because it's buggy, but because its extremely confusing. It's not even easy to write instructions about it. I would recommend looking for my Youtube channel if you are still confused.

Linking Mode is entered with shift + right-click, while any Universal Controller is in your hand. From there, you can right-click available peripherals, and you will see a bounding box.

The bounding box color tells you if the linked block has CC:Tweaked compat (yellow), or if the reason for the connection is purely because of Create's "Value Panels".

In the case of a connection to a block such as the Aeronautics Portable Engine, you will see a purple bounding box. This is because you are able to toggle that panel at the top between clock-wise and counter-clock wise. I know, its lame. I wish more people would add CC:Tweaked compat to their mods. I am not going to do any mixins to control their blocks so we have to deal with what we have.

I will work on this section later. I tried to add photos, but compressed screenshots basically doubled the size of the jar file. I might do it, but I'm working on another way.
